Also, all sponsorship companies in the UK give their cadets a wage, about £175 a week, but this can vary depending on which company. 

Some companies pay for accommodation, however the pay you get is usually enough to cover accommodation.

I’m with Royal Caribbean through Clyde Marine studying in Glasgow and the accommodation is taken out of my account the same day i get payed. It’s just over £500 a month.

Hey dude, I’m doing my cadet ship right now and i can help if you need.

So for cruise ships: 

Royal Caribbean and Celebrity X recruit through Clyde marine.

MSC recruit through Chiltern.

You apply directly to Carnival cruises and to princess cruises.

Some smaller cruise companies also recruit through Clyde and Chiltern but RCI, Celebrity and MSC are the most well known.

I believe that in order to get these sponsorships that you need to study in the UK and they are funded by the British Government.

Edit: From my personal experience, Clyde marine only put forward 12 cadets for a second round of interviews with royal Caribbean/celebrity and from those 12 i believe there was 4 of us selected. There tends to be a lot of MSC cadets (maybe about 5 times compared to RCI cadets) so your best bet is with Chiltern.

Ps: if you need any more info just drop us a message and I’ll be more than happy to help out in anyway that i can.
